observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black PlayStation 5 console with the PlayStation logo visible on the front. A white and black DualSense controller is placed in front of it. A coiled black cable is wrapped in plastic next to the console.

Photo 1 shows the same console from a side angle, revealing the black side panel with ventilation slots. The same controller and cable are visible. The console appears to be in a clean, well-lit environment.
The console has a disc drive visible on the side, consistent with the PS5 model.
The controller has the standard DualSense design with touchpad, D-pad, and analog sticks.
The cable appears to be a USB-C to USB-A cable, wrapped in plastic.
No FIFA game disc is visible in either photo.
No other accessories (e.g., power brick, HDMI cable, cables) are visible in the photos.
